title: Minimum Operations to Transform Binary String
summary: Yes: a 0-to-1 operation may create an adjacent 11 pair for a subsequent simultaneous 11-to-00 operation. Operations may be repeated in any order, including temporarily changing a position that already matches the target. Each operation costs one. Return minimum cost or -1.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
clarification: Derived reachability, not an additional statement restriction: for n>=2 every state is reachable from every other state. Any adjacent pair can be made 00 by first filling its zeros with ones, then clearing it. Clear successive pairs across the string, then set target ones. At n=1, only 1 to 0 is impossible.
